name: TrackMania Nations Forever
notes: Use the dedicated DirectX 9 Metal path with TrackMania's tuned audio and scene settings. The OpenGL fallback is available if rendering fails, but can be considerably slower. Performance varies by hardware and track.

name: Counter-Strike 2
notes: Use DXMT for CS2's DirectX 11 graphics. The combined DirectX 9–11 profile also includes this backend. The owner confirmed working window controls and online matchmaking with normal Steam overlay handling. The latest online test was confirmed sharper and smooth with Metal presentation timing and a 1600x900 starting resolution. The preset targets 60 FPS; the 720p launch override is removed so later Video settings are respected. A sustained minimum across maps, displays and hardware is not established.
